title: Commander Shepard has a real face
caption: The default male Commander Shepard in Mass Effect is modeled on Dutch fashion model Mark Vanderloo. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #masseffect #commandershepard

instagram.caption:
The default male Commander Shepard in Mass Effect is based on a real face.

BioWare used Dutch fashion model Mark Vanderloo as the model for Shepard's face. He was not an actor and did no voice work.

So the hero who saved the galaxy three times on millions of screens has the face of a model from the Netherlands.

Default Shepard or custom?
